title: TFLite Micro libraries and useful examples

spans.text: TFLite Micro does not create a model; it is the runtime and supporting C/C++ library used to execute a prepared model. Train and convert on a computer, then run inference on the device. The right package depends on the board and framework: Espressif publishes an ESP-IDF component and examples; an Arduino project must use a library compatible with its exact board and core version.

spans.code:
idf.py add-dependency "esp-tflite-micro"
idf.py create-project-from-example "esp-tflite-micro:hello_world"
idf.py set-target esp32s3
idf.py build
idf.py -p PORT flash monitor

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: These commands are for an ESP-IDF project, not a direct Arduino IDE upload. Check each example's README for board, camera/microphone, memory, and framework requirements. Measure the tensor arena with the real model rather than guessing.
